scientific_integrity: The exact logarithmic-time identity and its consequences have an analytic proof in RESULT.md. Numerical tests in checker.py are supplementary, not infinity proofs. Earlier Lyapunov and polar identities are credited as premises. No independent validation or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the specified two-parameter planar homogeneous cubic family with a>0 and nonzero initial states is covered. The stable equilibrium is excluded from polar and ratio formulas. No conclusions about nonhomogeneous perturbations, noise or other flow families are made. Some earlier homogeneous-flow texts and the final remarks of the motivating manuscript could not be exhaustively inspected, so historical-priority risk remains.
title: Exact logarithmic-time amplitude and a sharp scaling lattice in a stable cubic flow
